summary.intent: Execute Phase 21 BYO-IPFS gap closure plans (21-08 through 21-11), then run a simplify code review pass, a security review, and resolve open PR review comments and CI failures.
summary.outcome: All 4 gap closure plans executed and verified (SDK config wiring, TEE-routed connection test, PinataProvider, performance baselines). Simplify and security fixes committed. All 5 PR review threads resolved. Two CI failures fixed (migration drift + broken test mock from find→count change).

repo: ByoIpfsConfig.protocol in packages/core was missing 'pinata', breaking Pinata config round-trips through the vault type system
BYO_IPNS_NAME_KEY constant is defined in StorageTab.tsx but useAuth.ts used the raw string 'cipherbox-byo-ipns-name' — the constant lives in StorageTab, not a shared file
formatBytes utility already exists in apps/web/src/utils/format.ts and is used by FileListItem, DetailsDialog, BinListItem — was duplicated in StorageQuota.tsx
Migration drift check CI job catches TIMESTAMP vs TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE mismatches — AddPinMigrations used WITH TIME ZONE but TypeORM @CreateDateColumn defaults to plain TIMESTAMP
MigrationProcessor communicates with TEE worker via raw fetch instead of using TeeService (pre-existing architectural gap)
probeKubo/probePsa logic is duplicated between packages/sdk-core and tee-worker — TEE version cannot probe Pinata endpoints
deriveByoConfigIpnsKeypair follows an established convention of separate named functions per purpose rather than a shared generic helper

code.finding: protocol union was 'psa' | 'kubo', missing 'pinata' — sdk-core's ExternalProviderConfig already had all 3
Private IP check duplicated verbatim in validateEndpointUrl and validateResolvedIp — extracted to isPrivateAddress() helper
SSRF blocklist missing 0.0.0.0, ::  (unspecified IPv6), fc00::/7 (unique-local), 100.64.0.0/10 (CGN RFC 6598), and IPv4-mapped IPv6 (::ffff:127.x.x.x)
DNS rebinding TOCTOU: DNS resolved once for validation, then fetch uses hostname again allowing attacker-controlled DNS to serve different IP. Fixed via ssrfSafeFetch() wrapper with redirect: 'error'
checkQuota called isUserByo (1 DB query), then for non-BYO users called getQuota which internally called isUserByo again — 2 identical vault table lookups per upload
startMigration used .find({where: {userId}}) to get total count — loads all PinnedCid rows into memory. Changed to .count()
authTokenString() decoded Uint8Array inside per-CID functions — up to 3N TextDecoder allocations per batch. Fixed by decoding once at batch start
5s polling interval started unconditionally on mount even when no migration exists. Also called setMigration on every poll even with identical values, causing unnecessary re-renders
Test mock for pinnedCidRepo only had find() method — broke when service changed to count(). Mock needed count: jest.fn() and test assertions updated from array to number

workflow: When the /simplify and /security:review commands make file edits, commit immediately — leaving them unstaged blocks git pull --rebase
GSD execute-phase --gaps-only filters to plans with gap_closure: true in frontmatter and skips plans with existing SUMMARY.md
Checkpoint plans with autonomous: false and human-action type cannot be auto-approved — require user to set up external provider credentials before the agent can run
The classifyHandoffIfNeeded Claude Code runtime bug fires in the completion handler after all tool calls finish — spot-check SUMMARY.md and commits to determine real success/failure
After GitHub web UI merges (e.g. merging main via web), the remote branch diverges from local — reconcile with git merge origin/<branch> then resolve any conflicts
Security review should check SSRF implementations for: missing IP ranges (0.0.0.0, CGN, IPv4-mapped IPv6), redirect-based bypass (redirect: 'error'), and DNS TOCTOU patterns

friction: Pinata JWT had a leading 'b' typo when pasted — required re-paste before authentication worked
GitHub connectivity intermittently failed (port 443 timeout) blocking git fetch and pull multiple times, requiring retries
Branch diverged after a GitHub web UI merge, requiring manual reconciliation and ROADMAP.md conflict resolution
Uncommitted simplify/security edits blocked git pull --rebase — should have been committed before the pull attempt
CI migration drift failure only discovered after push — AddPinMigrations used TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE inconsistently with other migrations and TypeORM defaults
CI API test failure from find→count refactor not caught locally until running full test suite — individual test file runs passed
open_items: probe logic (probeKubo/probePsa) duplicated between packages/sdk-core and tee-worker — TEE version also cannot probe Pinata endpoints; needs shared protocol-agnostic library
DualPinProvider.pin() runs primary then secondary sequentially — could use Promise.allSettled() to overlap the two uploads
BYO config load/decrypt logic duplicated between useAuth.ts and StorageTab.tsx — extract to shared loadByoConfigFromIpns() utility, cache result in store
MigrationProcessor uses raw fetch instead of TeeService for TEE communication — should be refactored into a separate PR
No rate limiting on 5 migration endpoints (MEDIUM security finding from review)
auth token string persistence — authTokenString() creates JS strings that survive until GC; MEDIUM security finding
MigrationStatus type union defined independently in migration.entity.ts, migration.service.spec.ts, and apps/web — will be resolved when orval api:generate is run
deriveByoConfigIpnsKeypair is near-identical to deriveVaultIpnsKeypair and deriveVaultKeyIpnsKeypair — could be unified into a private helper (pre-existing pattern, not newly introduced)
8 todo integration test cases in tee-worker/src/__tests__/ssrf-validation.test.ts need implementation
failedCidList uses unbounded comma-separated TEXT column — should use JSON array or separate table
Connection test runs Kubo→Pinata→PSA probes sequentially (max 30s timeout) — could run concurrently with Promise.any()
